notes: Names printed: W. McMICKEN AV. (60'), PROBASCO (NOT IMPROVED) 50', DECKEBACH AV. (40', 4in W.P.), MARSHALL AV. (50' printed at the right edge), ENSLIN (bottom right). Probasco runs across the top from the McMicken lot line (x~1770, end) to the right edge; Deckebach comes down from the top and ends at Probasco (T; the line continuing south at x~2817 is a lot line of block 1). West McMicken runs down the left edge (west line in the gutter) and meets Marshall at the bottom: a four-way crossing where Marshall's ENE leg and its west leg (60', to the canal bridge, sheet 275) cross McMicken's NW leg and its south leg (60', onto 256). The point is where both centrelines and both 8in water pipes meet. This crossing is also on 256 (at its top edge). Marshall's NE leg runs off the right edge just south of the 276/277 corner. Block 1 (between Probasco, McMicken lots and Marshall) and block 2 are vacant; all interior lines are lot lines. The line along the bottom (y~7335-7440) is the rear line of block 2; Enslin Street ends at it (only Enslin's west line is on this sheet).
